Rൾ඀ංඌඍඋൺඍංඈඇ ඈൿ Tංඍඅൾ Aർඍ Nඈ. 21 ඈൿ 1998
(Sൾർඍංඈඇ 55)

Reference the intestate property of late Mr. Senadheera Pathirannehelage Somachandra who resides in the village of Kamburagalle, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Aththanagalle, in the District of Gampaha. It is hereby notified that any person/s who have a claim to or interest in the intestate property of the late Mr. Senadheera Pathirannehelage Somachandra described in the Schedule hereto should submit his/their claim to the undersigned in writing before 25th March, 2024 stating his/their right or interest to such intestate property. In case of failure to do so, exparte action will be taken to register title under Section 55 (2) and (3) of the Registration of Title Act. No. 21 of 1998. P. C. D. SIGERA, Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Madura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla, 16th February, 2024.
(Published by Authority)
